divergences.name: HurtArmorPacket
divergences.reason: The canonical manifest writes Armor Slots as unsigned var_u64, while the pinned gophertunnel Marshal writes ArmourSlots with Varint64 (zigzag_i64). This is an oracle conflict, not a normalization equivalence: the independent protocol documentation and the existing gophertunnel drift adjudication both identify the unsigned shape, so the hand-written oracle is the likely defect.
divergences.what_would_settle_it: A protocol 2168 capture of HurtArmor bytes, or an upstream gophertunnel correction backed by an authoritative serializer, must establish whether the field is unsigned VarLong or zigzag VarLong; then update the oracle or canonical correction and remove this entry.

evidence.summary: Pinned HurtArmour.Marshal calls io.Varint64 for ArmourSlots.
The pinned prior adjudication records the same unsigned-versus-zigzag conflict and its independent-source rationale.

divergences.name: UpdateAbilitiesPacket
divergences.reason: The canonical manifest prefixes Layers with unsigned var_u32, while the pinned gophertunnel AbilityData Marshal uses SliceUint8Length and therefore an unsigned fixed u8 count. The array-prefix distinction is intentionally preserved.
divergences.what_would_settle_it: A protocol 2168 capture or independent serializer must identify the Layers count prefix; then update the canonical source correction or gophertunnel and remove this entry.

evidence.summary: Pinned AbilityData Marshal uses SliceUint8Length for Layers.
The prior reviewed divergence records the one-source-versus-one-source prefix conflict.

divergences.name: ServerPresenceInfoPacket
divergences.reason: The canonical manifest contains only the optional rich-presence value, while the pinned gophertunnel PresenceInfo type adds optional ExperienceName and WorldName and an unconditional RichPresenceID inside the outer optional. This can change packet length rather than merely field grouping.
divergences.what_would_settle_it: A protocol 2168 capture or exact reference serializer must identify the complete PresenceInfo payload and whether ExperienceName, WorldName, and RichPresenceID are on the wire; then correct the canonical shape or oracle and remove this entry.

evidence.summary: Pinned PresenceInfo Marshal includes optional ExperienceName and WorldName plus RichPresenceID.
The prior reviewed divergence records the same type and field-count disagreement.
